from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

        # Titles and lecture lines
        title_str = "Prerequisite: The Linear Equation as a Slider"

            "The bias, b, sets the threshold for making a decision."

            self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(W_COLOR),

        self.play(w_tracker.animate.set_value(0.5), run_time=2, rate_func=linear)
        self.play(w_tracker.animate.set_value(1.0), run_time=1)
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Slider for 'b'
        b_label = MathTex("b", "=", font_size=32, color=B_COLOR)
        b_val_num = DecimalNumber(b_tracker.get_value(), num_decimal_places=1, color=B_COLOR)
        b_val_num.add_updater(lambda d: d.set_value(b_tracker.get_value()))
        b_slider_group = VGroup(b_label, b_val_num).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.2)
        self.place_at_grid(b_slider_group, "E5", scale_factor=0.8)
        
        # Highlight third line

            self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(B_COLOR),

            run_time=0.5
        )

        # Animate 'b' slider effect: threshold (shift)

        self.play(b_tracker.animate.set_value(1.5), run_time=2, rate_func=linear)
        self.play(b_tracker.animate.set_value(-1.5), run_time=2, rate_func=linear)
        self.play(b_tracker.animate.set_value(0.0), run_time=1)

from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT, buff=0.3).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.5)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (6x6 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                # Adjusting center to the right half of the screen
                x = 1.5 + (j * 0.8)
                y = 2.0 - (i * 0.8)
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])

class Section2Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        # Title and Lecture Content
        title = "Neural Networks: The Structural Blueprint"
        lecture_lines = [
            "- Inspired by biological neurons",
            "- Information flows through layers",
            "- Nodes process input signals",
            "- Connections have varying weights",
            "- Activation functions decide output"
        ]
        
        self.setup_layout(title, lecture_lines)

        # Create Neural Network Visual Elements
        input_layer = VGroup(*[Circle(radius=0.2, color=BLUE, fill_opacity=0.5) for _ in range(3)])
        hidden_layer = VGroup(*[Circle(radius=0.2, color=GREEN, fill_opacity=0.5) for _ in range(4)])
        output_layer = VGroup(*[Circle(radius=0.2, color=RED, fill_opacity=0.5) for _ in range(2)])

        # Position Layers using grid logic
        # Input Layer at Column 1, Rows B-D
        for i, node in enumerate(input_layer):
            grid_key = f"{chr(66+i)}1"
            self.place_at_grid(node, grid_key)

        # Hidden Layer at Column 3, Rows A-D
        for i, node in enumerate(hidden_layer):
            grid_key = f"{chr(65+i)}3"
            self.place_at_grid(node, grid_key)

        # Output Layer at Column 5, Rows B-C
        for i, node in enumerate(output_layer):
            grid_key = f"{chr(66+i)}5"
            self.place_at_grid(node, grid_key)

        # Create Connections
        connections = VGroup()
        for i_node in input_layer:
            for h_node in hidden_layer:
                line = Line(i_node.get_right(), h_node.get_left(), stroke_width=1, color=GRAY_A)
                connections.add(line)
        
        for h_node in hidden_layer:
            for o_node in output_layer:
                line = Line(h_node.get_right(), o_node.get_left(), stroke_width=1, color=GRAY_A)
                connections.add(line)

        # Labels
        input_label = Text("Input", font_size=16).next_to(input_layer, DOWN)
        hidden_label = Text("Hidden", font_size=16).next_to(hidden_layer, DOWN)
        output_label = Text("Output", font_size=16).next_to(output_layer, DOWN)

        # Animation Sequence
        self.play(
            LaggedStart(
                FadeIn(input_layer),
                FadeIn(hidden_layer),
                FadeIn(output_layer),
                lag_ratio=0.3
            ),
            run_time=2
        )
        
        self.play(Create(connections), run_time=2)
        
        self.play(
            Write(input_label),
            Write(hidden_label),
            Write(output_label)
        )

        # Signal pulse animation
        pulse = Dot(color=YELLOW).move_to(input_layer[1].get_center())
        self.play(FadeIn(pulse))
        self.play(
            pulse.animate.move_to(hidden_layer[2].get_center()),
            rate_func=smooth,
            run_time=1
        )
        self.play(
            pulse.animate.move_to(output_layer[0].get_center()),
            rate_func=smooth,
            run_time=1
        )
        self.play(FadeOut(pulse))

        self.wait(3)
